outcome: number of packed red blood cell transfused
cohort: 51 pregnant women with invasive placentation who underwent planned cesarean section
finding: While major intraoperative and postoperative complications were comparable between the two groups, segmental resection was associated with lower blood loss and shorter operating time compared to cesarean hysterectomy.
mod_finding: Segmental resection, a fertility-conserving surgical procedure, was associated with less blood transfusion and shorter operative time compared to cesarean hysterectomy in patients with invasive placentation.
